title: Receive the nearness you keep overlooking
summary: The True Guru protects and cherishes the helpless child until the heart blossoms. Let longing ripen where the helpless child is still being cherished.
takeaway: Let longing ripen where the helpless child is still being cherished.
lifeApplication: At the next quiet ache, move toward saintly company and name the companionship being offered before the mind says alone.
